verdicts.evidence: The right column's heading reads "If something goes wrong", and its three numbered steps only cover writing a note and leaving it in the quay office box or posting it; nothing covers urgent help.
The first bullet says "the last boat leaves before dusk" and gives no clock time, and step 3 says "the address on the noticeboard in the shelter" without printing the address.

All four bullets are long sentences in the same regular weight with no bold lead words; the quoted reasons such as "so that the gangway is kept clear" actually come after the action, but the underlying claim still holds.
